resources.string: Local transfers are queued one at a time and continue when you close a tab. After restarting Telos, resume them here. Remote, root and archive operations use the existing transfer controls.
Paused — partial files are kept for resume
Transfer stopped. Check storage access and available space. Changed sources or destinations are preserved.
Copied, but some originals were retained because they changed or could not be removed.
Added to the file transfer queue
Could not add transfer. Finish or cancel pending transfers and check available storage.
This selection is too large to plan safely (10,000 entries, 64 folder levels or 4 MiB of metadata). Transfer smaller groups of files.
